articles.title: NASA Science Data Powers New Method to Discover Hard-to-Find Pulsars
articles.snippet: Open data from NASA’s Fermi mission helped an international team of scientists develop a method for finding pulsars about a million times faster than before.

articles.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 Makes History Reaching One Light-Day From Earth
articles.snippet: NASA’s Voyager 1 probe, humanity’s farthest-flying spacecraft, has reached one light-day from Earth, after more than 49 years of constant travel. A light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours, equaling about 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers). The spacecraft achieved the milestone at 2:16 a.m. PST (5:16 a.m. EST) Nov. 18. articles.title: Peru’s penguins are in trouble. A super El Niño could worsen things
articles.snippet: Bird flu, overfishing and warming seas have crashed the world’s largest colony of Humboldt penguins. Scientists are working to help them bounce back.

articles.title: El Niño Rains Paint the Atacama
articles.snippet: Winter precipitation helped wake dormant seeds in northern Chile, carpeting the desert with what may be the region’s most extensive flowering of the satellite era.
